description: This file defines localization and culture-specific information for the Estonian (Estonia) locale in the DateJS library. It includes culture details like names, date and time formats, regex patterns for parsing dates, time zones, and prototype extensions for date manipulation.

methods.name: clearTime
methods.description: Resets the hours, minutes, seconds, and milliseconds of a Date object to zero.

methods.name: setTimeToNow
methods.description: Sets the time of a Date object to the current system time.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates a duplicate of the current Date object.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Compares the current Date object with another date.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks if two Date objects are equal.

methods.name: getDayNumberFromName
methods.description: Returns the index of the day of the week given its name.

methods.name: getMonthNumberFromName
methods.description: Returns the index of the month given its name.

methods.name: isLeapYear
methods.description: Determines if a year is a leap year.

methods.name: getDaysInMonth
methods.description: Returns the number of days in a specific month of a given year.
